pm.seasoning: 5 dummy wafers run after the clean

claims.statement: PM-678 was wet clean wall buildup removed with showerhead new and seasoning 5 dummy wafers run after clean, baseline clean time 60.0 s pre PM recipe time 62.04 s target 500.0 A control limits 493.0 to 507.0 spec 485.0 to 515.0

History PM-193 same work wet clean showerhead replaced new with 5 dummy wafers seasoning had first wafers vs later -0.43 A and thickness slope -0.9 A per lot, while PM-265 seasoning skipped had -7.67 A showing seasoning makes first wafers reliable
Metrology matching reference 500.0 A MET01 reads 500.33 A MET02 reads 500.17 A difference MET02 minus MET01 -0.16 A checked 5.1 hours ago offset negligible
Monitor 3 runs since PM 3 at time 60.0 s on MET02 measured thickness 504.44 A implied rate 8.4074 A per s with one monitor left
Estimate using settled monitors rate 8.407 A per s recipe time 59.47 s change -4.14 pct would give 521.57 A with pre PM time out of spec

release.summary: Wet clean plus new showerhead raised rate - pre-PM time would run thick out of spec. After 5 dummy seasoning monitors settled at 504.4 A, rate 8.407 gives 59.47 s for target, change inside 8 pct cap. Metrology offset 0.16 A negligible. Same PM history shows steep thinning -0.9 per lot so set drift 0.9 and lambda 0.4 to track drift without chasing noise.

claims.statement: PM-678 was wet clean wall buildup removed with new showerhead, seasoning 5 dummy wafers already run, baseline clean time 60.0 s pre-PM time 62.04 s target 500 A control 493.0 to 507.0 spec 485.0 to 515.0

PM-193 with same work wet clean showerhead replaced new and 5 dummy seasoning had thickness slope -0.9 A per lot first 40 lots, while PM-265 with seasoning skipped had first wafers vs later -7.67 A thin, so our seasoning means first wafers are reliable and we expect about 0.9 A per lot thinning
Metrology matching certified 500.0 A MET01 reads 500.33 A MET02 reads 500.17 A difference MET02 minus MET01 -0.16 A - offset negligible so no correction needed
Monitor 3 at 60.0 s on MET02 measured 504.44 A runs since PM 3 confirming settled rate after seasoning
Using monitors 2 and 3 rate is 8.407 A per s recipe for 500 A is 59.47 s change vs pre-PM -4.14 pct within 8 pct cap and pre-PM 62.04 s would give 521.57 A which is out of spec

release.summary: Clean + new showerhead needed new rate. 2 stable monitors at 60s both ~504.4A give rate 8.407 and time 59.47s for 500A, -4.1% change inside cap. Metrology offset 0.17A negligible. History with same PM shows -0.9A/lot drift for ~40 lots so set drift 0.9 and lambda 0.4 to track without chasing noise. Seasoning already done so monitors are valid.
